C0079.title: MIIT Cracks Down on Malicious “Shake-to-Jump” Ads During 618 Shopping Festival
C0079.summary: On June 9, 2026, in response to splash-screen pop-ups and highly sensitive “shake-to-jump” information-window redirects during the 618 shopping promotion, MIIT required companies to conduct self-inspection and rectification. Some apps used highly sensitive shake triggers, pop-up windows, and similar mechanisms to mislead users into redirects, affecting normal browsing and user experience. MIIT said it would conduct regular monitoring, with violating apps subject to interviews, public notices, or removal.

references.title: MIIT Information and Communications Administration guides regulation of app information-window jump behavior
